name: Higglytown Heroes
description: In the colorful world of Higglytown, four kids and their squirrelly friend learn about the heroes that inhabit their city, from mail carriers and bus drivers to police officers and firefighters.

videos.title: To The Rescue
videos.overview:
Come visit Higglytown, the delightful, imaginative world where everyone is a hero.  Through engaging characters, lively music and storytelling, your children will learn about everyday heroes such as teachers, police officers, mail carriers, fire fighters and more.  Join the Higglytown Heroes as they work together, have fun together and play together.  Your child will discover that they, too, can be an everyday hero!

Best friends Eubie, Wayne, Twinkle, Kip and Fran hop and bop around the town visiting exciting places such as the fair, the circus and the candy store.  When a problem needs solving, they call on someone special to come to the rescue with safety tips and good advice on how we all can help each other.

videos.title: Heroes on the Move
videos.overview:
Take a journey to Higglytown, the wonderfully imaginative world where everyone is a hero.  The fun-filled stories and songs will introduce your children to the everyday heroes who keep the world moving with taxis, tugboats, submarines, planes and buses.

While out and about around Higglytown, best friends Eubie, Wayne, Twinkle, Kip and Fran visit the big city, the beach, the Ferris wheel and more.  Along the way, whenever they bump into a problem, they call on "someone special," and their friends and neighbors help them get back on track.  There are also important lessons about safety and how to be a good friend, all presented in an entertaining way that will show your child that they can be everyday heroes too!
